Subject: Trial pact outline and kickoff — draft GDoc

Hi Alicia —

Great to meet last week. Per our convo, I’m attaching a starter outline for the trial pact (MAP-style) and a proposed week0 kickoff timeline so your team can see how we typically structure success milestones and technical checkpoints. Key things we tried to surface:

- Acceptance criteria (dev & business)
- Week-by-week technical checks (infra, sample data, latency targets)
- Success metrics and who owns them on both sides
- Decision gates and sign-off artifacts

I've put a first-pass GDoc here: MAP_template_v1.gdoc (Drive link below). It’s intentionally concise — our goal is to turn this into a one-page cadence that your PM/TPM can use to run the trial.

Attachments: MAP_template_v1.gdoc (Drive link), week0-kickoff-timeline.xlsx

Next steps — could you share the primary technical contact at Zenith who will own the infra checklist and any procurement constraints (PO cadence, required terms) so we can fold that into the plan? If you’re good with the structure I’ll loop in Jasmine to fill in the technical runbook items and Ben to coordinate procurement.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.com]

Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial pact outline and kickoff — draft GDoc

Jordan — thanks for the draft. This looks like a useful starting point. A few quick notes from my side:

1) Procurement runs on 30-day PO cycles; our legal team will want to review any demo-data handling language.
2) Our infra lead is Marcus Ocampo (marcus.ocampo@zenithai.com) — he’ll own the connectivity and sample data prep.
3) We need an explicit acceptance criteria item for PII redaction and retention windows.

Can you add a short section for security controls and list the evidence we can supply for SOC2 / audit logging? Also please add a line for our legal reviewer (procurement@zenithai.com) so they can loop in counsel.

I’m available for a quick sync tomorrow afternoon if that helps to align on scope.

Best,
Alicia
Head of Product Partnerships | Zenith AI
Alicia.Trent@zenithai.com
